_comment: Transcribed from in-game screenshots taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture 20260801145248 / 20260801145253). Two shots per weapon: SELECT PRIMARY WEAPON for the text and stats, CUSTOMIZE for the art. TBD is deliberate: anything not legible on screen stays TBD rather than becoming a plausible-looking guess. Unlock and Requirement transcribed from the in-game challenge text (source: Battlefield 6), recorded 2026-08-01.
name: SOR-556 MK2

description.text: This modular rifle is in an intermediate configuration. Its highly accurate and best utilized at mid to long range engagements.

compatibility.source: Slot inventory read off this rifle's CUSTOMIZE overview screen, 2026-08-06. No slot was opened, so which attachments each holds is not recorded.
compatibility.note: Its Magazine slot holds nine options; only four were selectable on the capturing account, and the other five are compatible all the same.
